<description>
To protect privacy, the wallet picks a random target for the change output (#24494), inside a set range that is fixed for very small payments, otherwise random between CHANGE_LOWER and min(2 × payment, CHANGE_UPPER).  This function has no unit test at all. You could widen the range, or make it not random anymore,  and every test would still pass. This PR adds a unit test to the function `GenerateChangeTarget`

Mutations tested against the added unit test

- Boundary change
- Dropped change fee
- Wrong `randrange`
- Skewed distribution
- Halved upper cap
</description>

<commits>
6afb4a0a50 test: cover GenerateChangeTarget range and distribution

Add a unit test to check GenerateChangeTarget() returns the fixed
minimum for small payments, stays within its allowed range for larger
ones and covers most of that range.
</commits>
